analysis.purpose: The test suite for dossier — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: buildDossier — pure over soul + repoRoot; dossier persistence — sharded + atomic + hash-stale; dossierToMarkdown — deterministic human/agent projection; implementation status — the universal.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of dossier
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
